purpose: Teach: 突撃/下半身/名言/セレブ/鍼/歌舞伎町/ベッカム/旅人

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、戦時中の突撃部隊のお話を伺ったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer was telling me about the time they served in a combat unit during the war.
lines.style: Soft, reflective tone. Sharing something quietly felt. Slight pause before 'that customer'—remembering the weight of what was said. Warm toward both the customer and Aoi.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、リハビリで下半身の運動されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer mentioned they're doing lower-body exercises as part of their rehab work.
lines.style: Observant, noticing detail. Even pace, gentle. The tone of someone piecing together a person's story from small things they've shared. Curious without prying.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、店の名言ボードを楽しまれてるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: They really seem to enjoy looking at the quote board we have up.
lines.style: Warmth breaking through. Gentle pleasure in noticing something small that brings someone joy. Slight lift on 'really'—genuine affection for this detail.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、セレブのインタビュー記事を読まれてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They were reading through a celebrity interview article the other day.
lines.style: Conversational, easy. The tone of sharing a small, ordinary observation. No judgment—just noticing. Steady, natural pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、肩こりで鍼治療に通われてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They mentioned they've been going to acupuncture for shoulder tension.
lines.style: Gentle concern underneath. The noticing of small hurts. Quiet, unhurried delivery. A moment of care embedded in the observation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、歌舞伎町のジャズバーに通われてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They've been a regular at that jazz bar in Kabuki-cho, they said.
lines.style: Light, a little impressed. The tone of discovering something interesting about someone you thought you knew the outline of. Slight lift in energy, but still conversational.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ベッカム選手のドキュメンタリーを観てらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They were telling me about watching a Beckham documentary.
lines.style: Engaged, natural curiosity. The ease of someone sharing something a customer mentioned. Warm, no rush. Light and present.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、旅人として世界を回ってらしたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Apparently they've traveled the world as a traveler—spent years doing it.
lines.style: Quiet wonder. A little awe at the scope of a life lived that way. Reflective, as if picturing it. Slight trailing breath—imagining the distance.
